title: Dent's homepage: pick the mockup to build
question: Three full homepage mockups in Dent's real brand. Pick the one to build. Invented claims in the images (same-day, 5.0 stars, Google logo, emergencies) will not be copied; the build uses only true copy.

options.label: Photo-led
options.thesis: A full house photo behind a white headline panel, quote card on the right, proof strip, then two service photo cards.
options.viewport: Brick bungalow photo fills the hero; headline panel left, quote card right overlapping down; three proof points; Heating and Cooling photo cards.
options.risk: The most conventional of the three.

options.label: Owner-led with logo arc
options.thesis: A red-and-blue arc from his logo frames the photo; quote card overlaps it; a navy How a visit goes band.
options.viewport: Headline and big call button on white at left; arc-framed brick-row photo right with the Gateway Arch; quote card overlapping; four numbered visit steps in navy.
options.risk: The arc has to be built cleanly or it looks clip-art.

options.label: Heat and cool panels
options.thesis: Dusk photo under a navy tint with the skyline; icon choice buttons; red Heating and blue Cooling panels below.
options.viewport: White headline on a darkened brick home at dusk with the Arch skyline; quote card right with icon choices; Heating and Cooling panels with photos and icon lists.
options.risk: Dark hero is moodier; needs real Google review proof, not invented stars.
